sn12.42:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā-Phagavā etad avoca || || 3 Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa pañcabhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti || catūhi ca sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti || ariyo cassa ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho || so ākaṅkhamāno attanā va attānam vyākareyya || ||
sn12.42:1.3: Khīṇanirayomhi || pe|| avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano || || [Bhikkhave ti sabbam vitthāretabbaṃ] || || 3
sn12.42:4.1: Katamo cassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho || ||
sn12.42:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako paṭicca samuppādaññeva sādhukaṃ yoniso manasi karoti || pe || ||
sn12.42:4.3: Ayam assa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho || || 6
sn12.42:5.1: Yato ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imāni pañcabhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti || imehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti || ayaṃ cassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho || So ākaṅkhamāno attanā va attānaṃ vyākareyya || ||
sn12.42:5.2: Khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto || sotāpanno ham asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || ||
